text:
josh: PTAL — addressed the review comments on PR #4325. Split the big kv-cache change into two commits (allocator + eviction), added unit tests, and updated the e2e timeout heuristics. Smoke script added: scripts/smoke_canary.sh. I also added a small perf note and memory profile in the PR description.

maria: thanks — quick q: the integration CI is red on one flaky (kv_allocator_test::rotation). Did you change order of init?

josh: yep, reordered the background init to avoid a race. CI is green locally. Re-run command I used: `./scripts/ci-rerun.sh --pr 4325 --focus kv_allocator_test`. Left a comment in the PR with the exact log snippet.

alex: I can give a quick pass around 1:30p PT. Heads-up: our canary slot is at 3pm PT today. If we don't merge before the slot we'll probably miss today and wait until tomorrow's window. Also need a second approver from runtime (pinging @diane).

diane: noted — I'll eyeball mem/regressions. Quick question: does this bump resident memory on the hot path? Canary infra has a 5% mem headroom; anything higher triggers fallback.

josh: added a small memory profile in the PR description (summary + flamegraph link). Worst-case increase ~3.2% at 128-token streams, so should be safe. I also added an optional flag `--kv-alloc-mode=compat` for emergency rollback.

maria: LGTM for the config and tests, left one tiny nit about a log message (suggested clearer wording). Nothing blocking from my side.

diane: ok, I'll do a focused pass on perf and the canary smoke script in ~30m. If all looks good I can approve and we can aim for the 3pm slot.

ci-bot: re-run kicked off: build #789 (PR 4325) — tests queued.

josh: thanks all — re-requesting review after those nits addressed. PTAL when you get a moment. If anyone is blocking merge timing, say now so I can coordinate with release scheduling. :thumbsup:
